# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 26 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices: Slowest First Half Since 2020

- **Private residential price index rose 0.5% QoQ in Q2 2026, easing from 0.9% in Q1** - URA's latest real estate statistics show landed homes drove the overall gain, while non-landed prices dipped in the same period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-q2-2026-report-breakdown/)

- **First-half 2026 condo price growth is the weakest since 2020** - URA's Q2 figures show resale transactions drove a 13.6% rise in total private home sales even as price growth slowed to its softest first-half pace in six years. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-condo-prices-just-had-their-slowest-first-half-since-2020/)

## HDB Resale Market: Prices Dip, Million-Dollar Sales Hit Record

- **HDB Resale Price Index fell 0.3% QoQ in Q2 2026, a second consecutive quarterly decline** - The index slipped further after a 0.1% drop in Q1, continuing a cooling trend even as overall transaction activity edged higher. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-fell-in-q2-2026-as-market-continues-to-stabilise/)

- **Million-dollar HDB flat sales hit a record 491 units in Q2 2026 despite falling overall resale prices** - The simultaneous dip in the broad price index and record high in top-end transactions marks a notable split in the resale market. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fall-for-a-second-straight-quarter-but-million-dollar-flat-sales-just-hit-a-record-high/)

## New Launches & Land Sales

- **Dunearn House launches as the first condo in Bukit Timah's Turf City transformation, with two-bedders from S$1.47 million** - Indicative prices start from S$2,799 psf, making it the first private residential launch in the new Turf City precinct. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/price-analysis-evaluating-dunearn-house-within-the-wider-bukit-timah-and-ccr/)

- **Bayshore Drive mixed-use GLS site awarded to Frasers-led consortium at S$1,323 psf ppr** - URA awarded the tender to Gemini Residential Pte. Ltd. and Gemini Trustee Pte. Ltd., the highest of three bids received when the tender closed on 15 July 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bayshore-drive-gls-1280-homes-integrated-mrt/)

- **October 2026 BTO launch offers 7,970 flats across seven projects** - Sites include two Bayshore locations near Bayshore MRT, a likely Prime-classified project in Toa Payoh, and Tengah's first BTO launch in three years. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/we-review-the-october-2026-bto-launch-sites/)
